_note: Which sprite animation each player state shows. 'frame' freezes one frame. '{attack}' in a name is replaced by the running attack's or finisher's id (priest1/priest2/priest3, revolver), so each plays its own animation. null = placeholder rectangle (body shorter than the art). Update as new pose sets are built. Extra visual keys (not player states): walk (slow run), pray (at an altar), climbStill (on a ladder, not moving).
